title.narrative: TORCHES (Towards Resilient Communities with Health, Equality and Safety for all) Phase IV

description.narrative: This will be the 4th and final phase of the project. SASA! A behaviour change approach is being implemented with community wide sessions, women only sessions and drama groups. It is used to reduce VAWG, by challenging patriarchal beliefs and encouraging communities to become activists against SGBC and hold each other accountable. Phase 4 is the ‘Action Phase’ where activities, leaders and allies will lead efforts to support community members power to take action and sustain that change for years to come – solidifying new norms in which violence against women is never acceptable and women can live safe, fulfilling and dignified lives. The TORCHES project also has a disability inclusion aspect to it that is applied throughout.
